points.description: States that the size of the ice cube decreases as time increases (equivalent wording such as 'gets smaller/shrinks over time' earns the mark). The answer must link size and time in this direction.

rubric.notes: Full mark for a one-sentence answer saying the ice cube gets smaller as time passes, in equivalent wording. No partial credit: an answer that describes the graph's axes without giving the decreasing trend, or that states the opposite trend, earns no mark.
